summary: Frontend smoke test of public surfaces of the 'Let It Go' EI OS app. Verified that the recently fine-tuned AmbienceContext (rain gain 0.32, ocean 0.42 + LFO 0.22, forest 0.28, breath bandpass) does NOT crash the React tree on load. All public routes render cleanly, /app correctly redirects unauthenticated users back to / via ProtectedRoute, admin analytics renders KPI cards + Recharts with the supplied token, and the i18n switcher reliably swaps hero/nav copy across EN/ES/FR (and 6 other locales) with zero errors.
action_items: None blocking. AmbienceProvider mounts at App shell level cleanly — no AudioContext/Web Audio errors on any route. User can perform the subjective audio quality check after a real Google sign-in; nothing in code is preventing the graph from being built once the user toggles a preset.
critical_code_review_comments: AmbienceContext.jsx: useEffect on `volume` correctly updates masterRef.current.gain.value, but does so via direct property assignment which bypasses the AudioParam scheduling system. Fine for volume slider UX, but if a fade is already mid-ramp (during sound-switch fade-in lines 197-199), this can step on the linearRampToValueAtTime. Low priority.

AmbienceContext.jsx line 186: the 280ms setTimeout for fade-out cleanup races with the new graph being built starting on line 201 — if the user rapidly switches presets, the previous noise source may still be ramping down while a new one starts. Audible only on rapid toggling; not a crash.

AmbienceContext.jsx line 133: setInterval handle for forest 'bird' pings uses `9000 + Math.random()*6000` once at registration — meaning the *interval* is fixed at construction, so birds chirp at a constant cadence instead of random. To get true randomness, recreate the interval after each tick (or use setTimeout recursively). Cosmetic.

/api/auth/me returns 401 for unauthenticated visitors — this is correct behavior but it does emit two 401 console errors per page load (AuthProvider hits it twice on mount). Consider gating the probe behind a localStorage hint or suppressing the error log; not user-visible but noisy in DevTools.

ProtectedRoute redirects /app -> / on unauthenticated visit, which is fine, but the user briefly sees the landing page rather than a dedicated sign-in screen. Acceptable UX, but if Emergent OAuth is the intended entry, a direct redirect to the Emergent auth URL would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 critical flows pass: landing render, /app redirect-without-crash, 4 profession pages, admin analytics with token, i18n EN/ES/FR switch)

test_credentials: Admin token Dx4d1IIhLTg5Ct_luV9Frd3XACckoJi5iufadpC8D6lYc6P4MEZj1w confirmed working against /admin/analytics. Google OAuth not testable headless (per problem statement) — only verified that the unauthenticated redirect does not throw.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two `Failed to load resource: 401` console messages observed on every page load are NOT errors — they are the AuthProvider's expected probe of /api/auth/me for an unauthenticated visitor. No real JS exceptions, no pageerror events. AmbienceProvider only constructs an AudioContext on first user-triggered sound switch (lazy via ensureContext on line 151), so a logged-out visitor never instantiates audio — that's why no AudioContext errors show up. To exercise the real audio graph you must sign in (Emergent Google OAuth) and toggle a sound preset; that path is user-only.
